notes.title: Status Update
notes.content: There's been an unexpected delay with the launch, but the game should be live within a day. In the meantime you can get some practice by playing the Cutthroat beta and join the [url=https://discord.gg/kkQMvUB] Discord channel [/url] to find others to play with online.
